implementation.method: Qt5 Widgets QSS and role-derived generated assets; Qt owns native input/state semantics and scrollbar range

real QProgressBar with recipe state mapping

implementation.checkbox_contract: QCheckBox retains native check state and click semantics; its 14x14 normal and checked indicator assets are generated from Motif symbolic art and the current KDE semantic roles. Four-scheme probe toggles the real widget and verifies zero pixel difference against the matching generated asset.
implementation.toggle_contract: first click selects and keeps sunken relief; second click clears selection and restores normal relief
implementation.backend_note: Fixed a pre-existing capability metadata scoping issue: native_gallery, translated_controls and recipe_applied now remain attached to each family within the backend loop; Qt5 Xephyr preview previously failed with KeyError before this fix.
implementation.radio_contract: Two real QRadioButtons in an exclusive QButtonGroup transfer selection on click. The checked and unchecked 14x14 indicators are generated from Motif symbolic art and the current KDE semantic roles; the probe verifies exact generated asset pixels in both states.
implementation.entry_contract: QLineEdit retains Qt editing, cursor and selection semantics. Normal/backdrop/disabled faces and text use KDE View roles; selection uses KDE Selection roles; focused relief derives from the KDE focus role; padding is the recipe control_padding_px.
implementation.spin_contract: Real Qt5 QSpinBox and QDoubleSpinBox retain native range, mouse stepping, keyboard stepping and disabled behavior. Generated up/down arrows use semantic KDE roles for normal, pressed, backdrop and disabled states; spinner button relief uses current button roles. Four-scheme matrix verifies native interaction and exact visible arrow pixels, ignoring transparent pixels composited over the face.
implementation.text_contract: Real QTextEdit multiline editor retains native typing and text selection; normal, focused, backdrop and disabled surfaces, selection colors and recessed/focus relief derive from KDE View, Selection, Window and Focus roles. Probe verifies native edit/selection/disabled state and exact normal/disabled face pixels across four schemes.
implementation.scale_contract: Real horizontal and vertical QSlider controls retain native range, mouse and keyboard semantics. Track relief and thumb faces/states are generated from current KDE Button, Window and Focus roles; geometry derives from recipe thumb_cross_px and shadow_px. The QSS avoids opaque page overlays that hid the recessed track. Native probe verifies mouse, keyboard and disabled behavior in both orientations.
implementation.arrow_contract: A real QToolButton uses recipe-sized down-arrow glyph assets generated from the shared Motif symbolic artwork and current KDE semantic roles. Normal/backdrop/pressed/disabled glyph pixels are compared against the rendered widget; click signals and disabled state are checked. No final RGB values are hard-coded.

arrow_interaction_test.widget: RecipeArrowButton subclass of real PyQt5 QToolButton

implementation.progress_contract: A RecipeProgressBar subclass retains native Qt range, value, fill fraction and formatted text. It maps normal/backdrop/disabled/focused states to a domainosState property for QSS; track/fill/bevel derive from KDE View, Selection and Focus roles, while text inherits Qt palette Text. No final RGB is fixed.
implementation.list_contract: A real QTreeWidget retains Qt single-row selection, focus, keyboard navigation and internal scrolling. Row surfaces use KDE View roles and the selected row uses KDE Selection roles; all colors are generated from the active scheme. Its selection and disabled states were verified with nonzero pixel deltas.
implementation.frame_contract: Real QFrame with native Panel/Sunken semantics and a 2 px line width from recipe shadow_px. Surface and normal/backdrop/disabled bevel colors derive from KDE View and Window roles. Four-scheme probes compared normal/disabled center pixels with the generated semantic-role values.

palette_matrix.scope: Four isolated KDE schemes; real Qt5 widgets including standalone arrow and progress bar; offscreen, no profile writes.
palette_matrix.contrast_method: WCAG relative luminance ratio; diagnostic only, no static color override
palette_matrix.contrast_note: DomainOS roles are white on #78a0d5 (2.70:1); this comes from the selected schema and remains unmodified. TestYellow selected roles measure 11.86:1.
palette_matrix.checkbox_assertion: For each of DomainOS, BreezeLight, BreezeDark and TestYellow, a real QCheckBox toggled checked then unchecked; the captured 14x14 indicator matched the corresponding generated role-based asset with 0 differing pixels.
palette_matrix.radio_assertion: For DomainOS, BreezeLight, BreezeDark and TestYellow, an exclusive real QButtonGroup transferred selection between QRadioButtons; checked and unchecked 14x14 indicator crops matched generated role-derived assets with zero differing pixels.
palette_matrix.entry_assertion: For all four schemes, the real QLineEdit accepted keyboard input and selection, entered focus/disabled states, and its sampled normal/disabled face pixels matched the KDE-role colors emitted in the generated QSS.

text_editor.scope: one real QTextEdit; Qt retains multiline editing, keyboard, selection and clipboard semantics
